implementationFacts: A final-token preprocessing pass consumes _Pragma produced by macro expansion, validates its single string operand, destringizes it, and reuses the existing pragma classifier; malformed operands report E0112.
The first token substituted for a macro parameter inherits the whitespace flag of the parameter occurrence, while subsequent spelling flags remain unchanged.
Pointers to function and qualified void pointers use one conversion rule across initialization, assignment, arguments, returns, casts, and conditional operands.
Static address constants compose through measured conditional conditions and label addresses; label-address execution and lowering retain the existing E3029 fail-closed boundary.
memmove uses its ordinary library call identity, while prefetch and extract_return_addr receive their frozen builtin prototypes without undeclared-identifier diagnostics.
The shared MemoryPlace validator reconstructs decay through array members and conditional arms instead of admitting kfifo syntax by name; a direct forged integer place root remains invalid.

fullConfigurationSurvey.scopeDiscipline: The survey was measure-only; none of the remaining typed frontier was investigated or fixed.

processDeviations: The first survey invocation correctly refused before enumeration because the dashboard publisher had changed a tracked receipt. The 48/48 receipt was committed, and the accepted survey ran on that exact clean subject.

The shared main branch advanced with one middle-end commit after the survey subject was sealed. The no-local clone was explicitly detached to b3a2af6 so the replay proves the same front-end subject rather than silently including later work.

A restricted base-layout invocation before the implementation commit returned one without evidence. It was rejected; every recorded base and attributed result comes from a permission-correct sequential invocation.

The first final workspace invocation launched no tests because the host linker exhausted disk space while five isolated Cargo target trees coexisted. That run is rejected. Only those task-specific reproducible build directories were removed; source, logs, sealed evidence, and the no-local clone were retained. The identical command then completed 1287/1287 with one ignored test.
claimCeiling: The six declared front-end capabilities pass, the 16-unit dashboard remains 48/48 clean, and 2,760 of 2,798 full-configuration target units are clean with zero unavailable, timeout, or panic. The remaining 38 typed diagnostics are a measured frontier, not a general front-end-conformance claim.
